# Holochart (vendored)

Built from https://github.com/holochart/holochart at commit
`0248f416ee6c3e0fd0d5109160b7eb6394cfda4f` with:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --filter @mk7s/holochart... build
```

Copied from `packages/holochart/dist/`: `holochart.iife.min.js` (bundles three.js)
and `fonts/` (TeX Gyre Heros, GUST Font License), which the script loads from
alongside itself. Source maps are omitted. Holochart is MIT-licensed (`LICENSE`);
bundled third-party licenses are listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`.
